verdict.rationale: Better Auth is an open-source npm library installed into your own codebase, backed by your own self-hosted database (SQLite/Postgres/MySQL), with 'no dashboard clicks... your auth lives in code' and community confirmation that 'you get all of your auth data in your own db' with no vendor lock-in. This directly satisfies self-hosting the core auth framework. Missing for 10: no explicit dedicated self-hosting deployment guide/docker instructions, and one community comment raises concern about future closed-source cloud dependency risk (though not a current contradiction).
